title: Placement
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a venue mark’s position according to the communication’s focus and to repeat the decision across related formats.
strategic_value: Stable placement can identify the venue quickly while a centered mark can lead a piece devoted to the site itself.
demonstration: Three gray formats compare the Millennium Gallery mark fully centered, top centered and left aligned, with primary and secondary uses labeled.
practical_value: Try top center for general venue use and full center when the venue itself is the focus. Check the placement of related materials before varying it.

content_islands.name: Placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the heading and left text with the guidance about format and series consistency.

content_islands.name: Centered placements
content_islands.spec: Use a small field for the fully centered specimen and a taller field for the top-centered specimen. Label both primary uses.

content_islands.name: Secondary alignment
content_islands.spec: Place the left-aligned mark in a wide field beneath the smaller specimen and label the alternate position.
